outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a bar chart of Mean±s.d. cell death from three independent experiments, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B shows a bar chart of cell death percentages, but no individual data points are shown alongside the bars.
Panel C shows grouped bar charts of Mean±s.d. cell death from three experiments at multiple time points, but no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel D shows a bar chart of cell death (mean with error bars), but no individual data points are displayed on the bars.
